basic_details.job_title: UoH Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Junior Research Fellow / Project Associate 1 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Centre for Advanced Studies in Electronics Science and Technology (CASEST), School of Physics, University of Hyderabad, has invited applications for one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) / Project Associate 1 position in the research project "Development of a novel NDT instrument using 3d Asymmetric Giant Magnetoimpedance Sensors for Coal mines". The tenure is six months or the end of the project, whichever is earlier, with fellowship as per DST rules and no HRA. Applicants need an MSc/MTech or BTech (EEE & ECE) as described below, with minimum 60 % marks or CGPA 6.75. Indian nationals only may

how_to_apply: Prepare the application on plain paper or in the attached Form B (Application for Position in the Project).

Form B asks for the post applied for, notification number and date, personal details, address for correspondence, present position, educational qualifications, experience, and the names and addresses of two referees.
Paste a recent photograph on Form B and sign the declaration.
Enclose self-attested copies of all certificates supporting the information given in the application.
Add extra documents such as a CV to support the application.
Email the application to [email protected] and [email protected].
Make sure the application is received by 14 November 2026.
The notice does not specify an email subject line. Application fee payment details in Form B read "Not Applicable".
important_instructions: The appointment is purely temporary, with no right to claim a regular appointment in the University. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the written test / skill test or at the time of joining. Only eligible candidates will be informed by email/letter at a later date. If anything in the application is found false at any stage, the candidature may be cancelled without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: About UoH
content_sections.text: The University of Hyderabad is located at P.O. Central University Campus, Gachibowli, Hyderabad - 500 046, Telangana. The post sits in CASEST, which is part of the School of Physics. The position is for a research project, and the appointment is purely temporary.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals can apply. The notice lists one post, with the conditions below. Relaxation in the qualification marks will be as per GOI norms. Age limit: 30 years, with relaxation as per GOI norms. Form B asks for date of birth and age as on the last date of the Notification. The official notification gives no experience requirement. Candidates should check the notification for any discipline-specific eligibility details.

rows.essential_qualification: MSc/MTech Electronics, Physics, Applied Physics, Materials Science, Nanotechnology or in relevant disciplines, BTech EEE & ECE, with minimum 60 % marks or CGPA 6.75 (on a 10-point scale)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship / honorarium / stipend is "as per DST rules"; the notice prints no rupee amount. HRA is not applicable. The tenure is six months or the end of the project, whichever is earlier. The appointment is purely temporary, and appointees have no right to claim any regular appointment in the University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the UoH JRF / Project Associate 1 post?
faq.answer: MSc/MTech Electronics, Physics, Applied Physics, Materials Science, Nanotechnology or in relevant disciplines, BTech EEE & ECE, with minimum 60 % marks or CGPA 6.75 (on a 10-point scale). Relaxation is as per GOI norms.
